basic_info.description: Expansive top-floor condominium in the coveted North-of-Lake neighborhood near the Presidio. Enjoy endless outdoor activities with miles of hiking and biking trails, golf, tennis, and nearby Mountain Lake Park. The Presidio Shuttle offers easy access to Downtown SF and the Transbay Terminal.Close proximity to the vibrant shops and restaurants of Clement Street, California Street, and Laurel Village, with Golden Gate Park just eight blocks away!    This elegant and light-filled residence showcases stunning period details and a well-designed layout. Features include a spacious foyer, two generous bedrooms, 1.5 beautifully remodeled baths, a grand living room with a fireplace, a formal dining room, and an updated eat-in kitchen with granite countertops and Viking appliances. Additional highlights: in-unit laundry, a private storage room with a window and high ceilings (ideal for an office), one-car garage parking, and a lush, deep backyard with a deck, patio, and mature trees. A truly exceptional property!
